translate_en|mods/AmmoLootDropB42/42/med:
Percent chance per round type, on
each zombie you kill.

Every type you leave on rolls on
its own, and most zombies roll the
whole list twice. With all 9 on
that is 18 rolls per corpse.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>That is why 5 does not mean 5% of
zombies. It leaves ammo on about
60% of them.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>20 covers nearly every zombie, so
raise it gently.

<RGB:1,1,1>Set to 0 to turn the drop off.

OFF: every zombie can drop ammo.
That is how it has always worked.

ON: only zombies who would have
been carrying drop any, and only
what fits their gun:

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>Soldiers - every kind
Hunters and rangers - most kinds
Police and bandits - pistol, shells
Farmers - rifle and shells
Detectives, mobsters - pistol only

<RGB:1,1,1>Everyone else drops nothing, and
barely one zombie in a hundred out
in town is dressed for it.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>So look where those people worked:
police stations, army bases,
prisons, farms and bars.

<RGB:1,1,1>Raising the drop rate helps, but
will not make the suburbs pay.

How much a drop is worth. A drop that
lands leaves a random 1 to this many
rounds.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>This does not change how often ammo
turns up, only how much of it. The
drop rate above is what changes that.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>Each round type rolls its own amount,
so a corpse carrying two calibers
rolls a number for each.

<RGB:1,1,1>At the default 10 a corpse that is
carrying holds about 8 rounds, which
is worth bending down for.

Set it to 1 for a single round, the
way this mod worked before 42.10.

A corpse only carries so much, so a
very high number is cut short on one
that is already loaded.

translate_en|mods/AmmoLootDropWeaponB42/:
Percent chance that a zombie you
kill is carrying a gun.

This is the total, not the chance
per gun. It is split across every
kind you leave on, so switching a
caliber off changes which gun turns
up, never how often one does.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>Most zombies roll twice, once for
their outfit and once for the
default pool, so 0.1 leaves a gun
on about 1 corpse in 500.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>A gun is worth a great deal more
than a handful of rounds, so raise
it gently.

<RGB:1,1,1>Set to 0 to turn the drop off.

OFF: every zombie can drop a gun,
office workers and nurses included.

ON: only the zombies who would
have been carrying one drop any,
and only what suits them:

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>Soldiers - every kind
Hunters and rangers - every kind
Police and bandits - pistols and
shotguns
Farmers - shotguns and rifles
Detectives, mobsters - pistols

<RGB:1,1,1>Everyone else drops nothing, and
barely one zombie in a hundred out
in town is dressed for it.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>So look where those people worked:
police stations, army bases,
prisons, farms and bars.

<RGB:1,1,1>Raising the drop rate helps, but
will not make the suburbs pay.

ON: the magazine a gun feeds from
drops at the same rate, so a rifle
off a corpse is not dead weight.

It rolls on its own, so it will not
always land on the same zombie as
the gun it belongs to.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>Only the 7 guns that take one are
affected. Revolvers, shotguns and
the bolt rifles feed loose rounds
and never needed it.

<RGB:1,1,1>OFF: guns only.

MSR7T Tactical Rifle
M1A Rifle

M16 Assault Rifle
JS-14 Rifle

JS-2000 Shotgun
Sawed-off JS-2000 Shotgun
Double Barrel Shotgun
